plugins.verifyConditionsCmd: set -eu; count=$(grep -cE '^version = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"$' pyproject.toml || true); if [ "$count" != 1 ]; then echo "release_version_mismatch: expected exactly one version literal line, found $count"; exit 1; fi; probe="preflight-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)-$$"; echo "signing pre-flight: starting"; git tag "$probe"; git verify-tag "$probe" >/dev/null; git tag -d "$probe" >/dev/null; echo "signing pre-flight ok: $probe"
plugins.prepareCmd: set -eu; expected="${nextRelease.version}"; before=$(grep -cE '^version = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"$' pyproject.toml || true); if [ "$before" != 1 ]; then echo "release_version_mismatch: expected exactly one version literal line before the substitution, found $before"; exit 1; fi; sed 's/^version = "[^"]*"/version = "'"$expected"'"/' pyproject.toml > pyproject.toml.tmp; after=$(grep -cxF "version = \"$expected\"" pyproject.toml.tmp || true); if [ "$after" != 1 ]; then rm -f pyproject.toml.tmp; echo "release_version_mismatch: the substitution produced $after lines equal to $expected"; exit 1; fi; mv pyproject.toml.tmp pyproject.toml
